covid19_open_data: Entity: COVID-19 observations by location and date; Grain: one row per location_key + date; Keys/metrics: location_key, date, place_id, wikidata_id, datacommons_id, country_code, country_name, aggregation_level, openstreetmap_id; Measures: new_confirmed, new_deceased, cumulative_confirmed, cumulative_deceased, cumulative_tested, new_persons_vaccinated, cumulative_persons_vaccinated, new_persons_fully_vaccinated, cumulative_persons_fully_vaccinated, new_vaccine_doses_administered, cumulative_vaccine_doses_administered, population and population breakdowns (population_male, population_female, population_rural, population_urban, population_density, population_age_*), human_development_index, gdp_usd, gdp_per_capita_usd
population_by_country: Entity: historical population counts by country; Grain: one row per country (country) with wide columns for years; Keys/metrics: country, country_code; Measures: year_1960 through year_1997 population values (one column per year)
series_summary: Entity: metadata describing statistical series; Grain: one row per series_code; Keys/metrics: series_code, topic, indicator_name; Attributes: short_definition, long_definition, unit_of_measure, periodicity, base_period, aggregation_method, limitations_and_exceptions, source, related_indicators, license_type and other descriptive fields
country_series_definitions: Entity: mapping of series definitions for countries; Grain: one row per country_code + series_code; Keys/metrics: country_code, series_code; Attribute: description
series_times: Entity: time descriptions for series (appears duplicate of series_time); Grain: one row per series_code + year; Keys/metrics: series_code, year; Attribute: description
country_summary: Entity: country-level metadata and classifications; Grain: one row per country_code; Keys/metrics: country_code, short_name, long_name, two_alpha_code; Attributes: table_name, currency_unit, region, income_group, wb_2_code, national_accounts_base_year, system_of_national_accounts, ppp_survey_year, and various source/notes fields
health_nutrition_population: Entity: health/nutrition/population indicator observations; Grain: one row per country_name + indicator_code + year (i.e., country + indicator + year); Keys/metrics: country_name, country_code, indicator_name, indicator_code, year; Measure: value
international_debt: Entity: international debt indicator observations; Grain: one row per country_name + indicator_code + year; Keys/metrics: country_name, country_code, indicator_name, indicator_code, year; Measure: value
international_education: Entity: international education indicator observations; Grain: one row per country_name + indicator_code + year; Keys/metrics: country_name, country_code, indicator_name, indicator_code, year; Measure: value
footnotes: Entity: footnotes attached to series/year for countries; Grain: one row per country_code + series_code + year; Keys/metrics: country_code, series_code, year; Attribute: description
series_time: Entity: time descriptions for series (appears duplicate of series_times); Grain: one row per series_code + year; Keys/metrics: series_code, year; Attribute: description
indicators_data: Entity: generic indicator observations across topics; Grain: one row per country_name + indicator_code + year; Keys/metrics: country_name, country_code, indicator_name, indicator_code, year; Measure: value
